item.text: The current move endpoint stores only one `task_order`, so returning tasks can’t recover an earlier project position. I’ll add a durable per-task, per-project position table, seed it from existing task order, and use it when tasks move back.

The return slots are now stored independently of each task’s current project, and new tasks use the next position after all slots already established there. I’m checking the server and a move-out/move-back sequence before committing.

item.text:
Implemented and committed Task 012 as `5a2d460f2c9ea7291e767afcfee64ef9d14840a1`.

The server now remembers each task’s position in every project it has belonged to. Returning tasks regain their previous order, while first-time arrivals and new tasks are placed after positions already established in the destination.

Verified JavaScript syntax, `/health`, and a move-out/move-back ordering scenario. The working tree is clean. Run with `npm start`.
